overview_description.description: Hebi Robotics builds intelligent and connected building blocks for creating robotic solutions and uses these building blocks to deliver these solutions faster, better, and cheaper than current technology.  Well-defined interfaces, internet-enabled connectivity, and smart software tools allow implementers to spend their time focusing on the task at hand rather than low-level implementation details, resulting in faster development. The flexibility and reconfigurability of these tools allow robotic solutions to be more appropriately customized for their tasks, resulting in better robots. Finally, these both result in solutions that are cheaper, both due to reduction in development time and because customization means that only necessary parts are purchased.

about_short_description.short_description: Hebi Robotics provides robotics and tools.

product.name: HEBI Developer APIs
product.description: APIs for controlling HEBI robotic components in various programming languages, enabling hardware access from high-level kinematics to joint-level control.

product.name: Custom Robotics Solutions
product.description: Tailored robotic systems developed for industrial inspection and maintenance tasks using HEBI's modular platform.

product.name: Tready Ruggedized Mobile Base
product.description: A treaded mobile robotic platform designed for navigating rough terrain, climbing stairs, and accessing confined spaces for inspection and maintenance.

product.name: Raster Scanner
product.description: A robotic scanning system designed to automate phased array inspections of long, narrow structures such as wind turbine blades.
